units.source_text: 火车通过信号所时，窗外已经黑沉沉的了。

en.t: By the time the train passed the signal station, it was already pitch dark outside the window.

units.source_text: 在窗玻璃上流动的景色一消失，镜子也就完全失去了吸引力，

en.t: Once the scenery flowing across the window glass disappeared, the mirror completely lost its fascination,

units.source_text: 尽管叶子那张美丽的脸依然映在窗上，

en.t: although Yoko's beautiful face was still reflected in the window,

units.source_text: 而且表情还是那么温柔，但岛村在她身上却发现她对别人似乎特别冷漠，

en.t: and her expression was still so gentle, yet Shimamura discovered in her what seemed like an unusual coldness toward other people,

units.source_text: 他也就不想去揩拭那面变得模糊不清的镜子了。

en.t: so he no longer felt like wiping the mirror that had grown blurred and unclear.
